annotations.title: List content waiting for your approval

description:
[read-only] Content held for approval that waits on the account owner's decision, newest first: posts filed with publish `requiresApproval: true`, drafts submitted for review, and workflow runs parked at an approval gate. `kind` is "manual" or "workflow". Needs the explicit `approve` scope (admin does not include it). Agency plan.
(Wraps GET /api/v2/approvals.)
name: list_approvals
title: List content waiting for your approval
